## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List commands actually executed and their results. Identify tests that were not run or remain failing.

## Data, model and compatibility impact

Identify affected dataset/model versions, provenance, target definitions, interfaces and dependency changes. State whether any artifact was created and whether it remains exploratory.

## Related evidence

Link the relevant issue, report, evaluation or delivery manifest. Confirm that original source files and existing model versions remain preserved.
